content.intro: This lesson covers Browser-Based Rust Applications. It sits in Module 26, WebAssembly and Cross-Platform Rust, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.

content_blocks.text: Do not assume Browser-Based Rust Applications guarantees more than it actually does. Reduce a failure to a small reproducer, read the full compiler diagnostic or error value, consult the matching official reference, and change one assumption at a time.

content_blocks.title: Toolchain and execution boundary

Most standard-library examples can be tried in a Rust 2024 Cargo project; specialized networking, database, async, procedural-macro, embedded, and WebAssembly scenarios require the toolchain and dependencies described in their lessons.
